verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated `writing-skills` meta-skill that walks the agent through authoring a skill as TDD: write pressure-scenario tests, watch them fail, write the skill, watch it pass, then refactor. The plugin listing explicitly says it teaches skill authoring, and the skill notes the cross-runtime `~/.agents/skills/` location for placing skills. missing for 10: explicit packaging/distribution steps (plugin manifest or marketplace publishing for a new skill), a skill template/spec file, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the flow end to end.
